# Epic Boon: Night Spirit

<Feat
  category="Epic Boon"
  prerequisite="Level 19"
  ability="Dexterity or Wisdom">

Beneath the mangled moon, the dark is not an absence — it is a tenant, patient and old.
Steal into it often enough and it learns your shape, then lends that shape back to no one.

You do not hide in shadow. Shadow hides in you.

> “The dark keeps its own. Ask it, and it will keep you.”

---

<Feature cost="1 Minor Action" trigger="while you are in Dim Light or Darkness">

#### Shadowmeld

You become **Invisible**, along with anything you are wearing or carrying.
You remain Invisible until you move, spend an action point, or take a Reaction.

</Feature>

<Feature trigger="the first time you hit a creature while Invisible in this way">

#### Umbral Ambush

It takes an extra [% 2d10 psychic %] damage.

</Feature>

</Feat>
